#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <queue>

using namespace std;

class CF884F {
public:
    static const int A = 26, INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<int> oo, oh;
    int __;
    int link(int o, int h) {
        oo[__] = o; oh[__] = h;
        return __++;
    }
    vector<int> ii, jj, cc, ww, ww_;
    int m_;
    vector<int> ae, dd, kk, ff;
    vector<int> pq, iq;
    int cnt;
    
    void init(int n_val, int m_val) {
        oo = vector<int>(1 + m_val * 2);
        oh = vector<int>(1 + m_val * 2);
        ii = vector<int>(m_val);
        jj = vector<int>(m_val);
        cc = vector<int>(m_val << 1);
        ww = vector<int>(m_val);
        ww_ = vector<int>(m_val);
        ae = vector<int>(n_val);
        dd = vector<int>(n_val);
        kk = vector<int>(n_val);
        ff = vector<int>(n_val);
        pq = vector<int>(1 + n_val);
        iq = vector<int>(n_val);
        m_ = 0;
        __ = 1;
        cnt = 0;
    }
    
    void link_(int i, int j, int c, int w) {
        int h = m_++;
        ii[h] = i; jj[h] = j; cc[h << 1] = c; ww[h] = w;
        ae[i] = link(ae[i], h << 1);
        ae[j] = link(ae[j], h << 1 | 1);
    }
    
    bool less(int u, int v) {
        return dd[u] < dd[v] || (dd[u] == dd[v] && kk[u] < kk[v]);
    }
    
    int i2(int i) {
        return (i *= 2) > cnt ? 0 : (i < cnt && less(pq[i + 1], pq[i])) ? i + 1 : i;
    }
    
    void pq_up(int u) {
        int i, j, v;
        for (i = iq[u]; (j = i / 2) > 0 && less(u, v = pq[j]); i = j)
            pq[iq[v] = i] = v;
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }
    
    void pq_dn(int u) {
        int i, j, v;
        for (i = iq[u]; (j = i2(i)) > 0 && less(v = pq[j], u); i = j)
            pq[iq[v] = i] = v;
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }
    
    void pq_add_last(int u) {
        pq[iq[u] = ++cnt] = u;
    }
    
    int pq_remove_first() {
        int u = pq[1], v = pq[cnt--];
        if (v != u) {
            iq[v] = 1; pq_dn(v);
        }
        iq[u] = 0;
        return u;
    }
    
    bool dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        fill(dd.begin(), dd.end(), INF);
        dd[s] = 0; pq_add_last(s);
        while (cnt > 0) {
            int i = pq_remove_first();
            int k = kk[i] + 1;
            for (int o = ae[i]; o != 0; o = oo[o]) {
                int h_ = oh[o];
                if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int j = i ^ ii[h] ^ jj[h];
                    int d = dd[i] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? ww_[h] : -ww_[h]);
                    if (dd[j] > d || (dd[j] == d && kk[j] > k)) {
                        if (dd[j] == INF)
                            pq_add_last(j);
                        dd[j] = d; kk[j] = k; ff[j] = h_;
                        pq_up(j);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dd[t] != INF;
    }
    
    int trace(int s, int t) {
        while (t != s) {
            int h_ = ff[t], h = h_ >> 1;
            cc[h_]--; cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
            t ^= ii[h] ^ jj[h];
        }
        return 1;
    }
    
    int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
            dd[j] = min(dd[j], dd[i] + ww[h]);
        }
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
            ww_[h] = ww[h] + dd[i] - dd[j];
        }
        int f = 0;
        while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
            f += trace(s, t);
            for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
                int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
                if (dd[i] != INF && dd[j] != INF) {
                    ww_[h] += dd[i] - dd[j];
                }
            }
        }
        int cost = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
            cost += ww[h] * cc[h << 1 | 1];
        return cost;
    }
    
    void solve() {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        n /= 2;
        int n_ = 1 + n + A + 1;
        int m_ = n + n * A + A;
        init(n_, m_);
        
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        vector<int> bb(n * 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++)
            cin >> bb[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            link_(0, 1 + i, 2, 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = n * 2 - 1 - i;
            int ai = s[i] - 'a';
            int aj = s[j] - 'a';
            for (int a = 0; a < A; a++) {
                int b;
                if (a == ai && a == aj)
                    b = max(bb[i], bb[j]);
                else if (a == ai)
                    b = bb[i];
                else if (a == aj)
                    b = bb[j];
                else
                    b = 0;
                link_(1 + i, 1 + n + a, 1, -b);
            }
        }
        
        vector<int> kk(A, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
            int a = s[i] - 'a';
            kk[a]++;
        }
        
        for (int a = 0; a < A; a++)
            link_(1 + n + a, n_ - 1, kk[a], 0);
        
        cout << -edmonds_karp(0, n_ - 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF884F solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
